# three.js 0.170.0 (vendored)

A local copy so the twin, and the presenter view in particular, runs with no network:
`build/three.module.js` and the four addons the twin imports (OrbitControls, RoomEnvironment,
STLLoader, CSS2DRenderer), unchanged from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/.
MIT licence (LICENSE). `twin/index.html`'s importmap points here.
